amd-page-3.webp.zh: 艾哈迈达巴德机场航站楼的夜景：紫色灯光照亮悬挑屋面，斜撑立柱下是车道与落客区，檐口可见古吉拉特语的机场名。
amd-page-3.webp.en: The terminal at night — purple light washing the cantilevered roof, columns over the kerbside, and the airport name in Gujarati along the fascia.

amd-page-4.webp.zh: 从落客区望向航站楼正面：白色张拉膜雨棚在车道上方展开，玻璃幕墙与斜撑构成连续立面。
amd-page-4.webp.en: The terminal from the drop-off area — white tensile canopies over the roadway, with a continuous glass-and-steel frontage.

amd-page-5.webp.zh: 航站楼内的艺术墙：线描城市景观前立着两件铜色人物浮雕，右侧信息屏显示机场全名。
amd-page-5.webp.en: An art wall inside the terminal — two bronze figures in front of a line-drawn cityscape, with a screen showing the airport full name.
